messages:
olivia: Kicked off a LoRA merge for customer ZETA (base=zeta-7b, adapter=zeta-cs-lora). Pushed merge artifacts to /artifacts/zeta/lora-merges/1768001234. Need a compatibility + quantization smoke run and the quick_eval pack (zeta-smoke-v1). Can someone pick this up?

sam: I can take the quantize + quick_eval run. ETA ~30m. Any preferred batch/seq settings? @olivia

olivia: Use batch=8 seq=512, keep kv_cache on. Make eval deterministic (temp=0) so metrics are stable. Also note the prompt set includes a few PII obfuscation cases.

dinesh: FYI merged weights add ~0.6GB. The int8 path might need the new attention kernel flag. I'll profile kernels in parallel and watch p95.

sam: Running this locally now. Commands I'm using:
```
./tools/quantize --model /artifacts/zeta/lora-merges/1768001234 --bits 8 --out /tmp/zeta_q8
./tools/quick_eval --pack zeta-smoke-v1 --model /tmp/zeta_q8 --batch 8 --seq 512 --seed 42
```
Posting results here when done.

eval-bot: quick_eval job queued (id=q-1721). Estimated runtime ~22m.

olivia: Added core prompt set at /evals/zeta/smoke_prompts.json — includes edge cases (dates, obfuscated PII, multi-turn billing questions). Alert rule: if BLEURT drops >0.07 vs baseline, we hold rollout.

sam: Results in (q-1721): BLEURT delta = -0.03 vs customer baseline, avg latency p50 +12ms, p95 +70ms. Small hallucination bump on finance prompts (from 2% -> 3%). Logs: /logs/q-1721/artifact.json

dinesh: Those numbers look fine for a staged rollout. Kernel profile shows attention kernel fallback for sequence >384 but no major perf regressions. Suggest canary to 5% on Dedicated, enable prefix/KV caching for heavy prompts.

olivia: Sounds good. I'll open the rollout PR with the artifact links and the quick_eval report. Plan: canary 5% dedicated -> monitor BLEURT & hallucination rate for 24h, then expand. Thanks everyone :rocket:

sam: acked — will follow alerts and repost if anything spikes.

dinesh: I'll add a short note in the launch checklist about the kernel flag for int8 so infra enables it on canary nodes.

olivia: Perfect. Closing this thread after PR.
